source_title: Whole-Body Locomanipulation with KAIST Humanoid v0.9
source_context: Whole robot in walking three-quarter pose, approximate original ROI x920..1310 y100..1000. Native head, both actual grippers and both feet are complete. No blue KAIST letter overlaps body in this selected frame; letters are separate left. Preserve real exposed metal members, neck cables/white ties and dark gripper geometry, including transparent gaps proven by background; no extra human fingers or shells. Remove track, white lane lines, trees/buildings, letters and shadow via alpha only. Mandatory caption KAIST Humanoid v0.9 official video still, October 2026. This is exact current v0.9 configuration, not an older lower-body prototype. Footage does not by itself establish autonomy.
